Existing valid capability_show requests and fail-closed unknown-field behavior remain unchanged.

No lifecycle, Outcome delivery, authorization, performance, or release behavior changes are introduced.
goal: MCP capability_show schema properties and argument-key validation are projected from one protocol-owned parameter table, with parity tests proving future parameter additions cannot silently drift.
intent: Complete the BAML-style interface discovery boundary by removing the remaining hand-maintained MCP capability_show schema and allowed-field lists; protocol-owned parameter facts must remain the only interface fact source.

and user-global Agent or MCP configuration.
